DIAGNOSIS READY: Fibroadenoma

The mammogram description of a "smooth polylobulated mass" combined with a lack of skin changes or nipple discharge is highly suggestive of a benign lesion. While the patient reports rapid growth, which is atypical for a standard fibroadenoma, the imaging features strongly argue against invasive carcinoma or abscess at this stage. I will proceed with this diagnosis pending a biopsy to confirm the cellular nature of the mass.
